message: All matches concluded, and the Martial Festival qualifiers came to an end.
Momiji and Setsugekka had already secured their spots in the main tournament, so I had them head home early.
The only ones here now are Ririmu, who has regained consciousness, and Asahi, who was looking after her.
Ririmu is crestfallen and has been silent for a while now.

name: Iori
message: 「You both did your best today. Let's get some proper rest now.」
Neither Ririmu nor Asahi responds. Having lost the words they should say, they walk the path toward the dorms in silence.

name: Ririmu
message: 「……Hey, how did it go for you, Asahi？」
In that moment, it was Ririmu who broke the silence.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Just tell me. You're not the type to be bashful about something like that, right?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Well... I won.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I see. Congrats, Asahi.」
With her victory in today's match, Asahi had scraped into 8th place in the qualifiers, securing her spot in the main tournament.

name: Ririmu
message: 「*Sigh*... I guess I'm the only one who got knocked out of the qualifiers, huh?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ririmu...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「What's with that face, Asahi！ It's fine, really. I just didn't have enough strength, that's all there is to it.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「If I wanted to win for real, I should've listened to your advice and played a war of attrition, right?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But I didn't. Because that's just not my style！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I lost because of that, so it's all on me. It just means I wasn't strong enough to power through.」
Asahi looks like she wants to say something, but falls silent.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, my Martial Festival is over, but deciding what happens next is up to me.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Right? Isn't that so, Iori-rin?」

name: Iori
message: 「……That's right. It's cruel, but that's the world of competition.」
The 'style' Ririmu has been talking about... Unfortunately, this is as far as it goes this time.
A harsh reality every athlete faces at least once. She has to overcome it.

name: Asahi
message: 「Ririmu, I...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey, stop it, Asahi. It's not fair that you're making a gloomier face than me, the one who lost!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Asahi, you've still got the main tournament coming up. You should be thinking only about that right now.」
Up until now, Asahi had been refining her skills alongside Ririmu, analyzing their matches and pointing out each other's flaws together.
Perhaps that’s exactly why she couldn't just let it go.

name: Ririmu
message: 「More importantly, the real problem is that Arakawa-senpai has qualified for the main tournament, right?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Personally, that's what's actually frustrating me...！」
By securing a victory against Ririmu, Arakawa had locked in her spot for the main tournament as the 6th qualifier.

name: Asahi
message: 「...I suppose so.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ugh, seriously! Arakawa-senpai is so annoying!」
Just as they were talking about her, the person in question was nearby.

name: Sonomi
message: 「What? Oh, it's the phantom girl from earlier.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「It's Tobe Ririmu! At least try to remember my name!」
Arakawa approached with a languid look on her face.

name: Sonomi
message: 「My bad. I've got a crappy memory.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Besides, there's no point in remembering the name of some small-fry fencer, is there?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「...You really have such a foul mouth, you know that?！」
Perhaps still keyed up from the match, Ririmu snapped back.

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu, that's enough.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「No, this isn't a situation where I should be holding back. Sensei, just stay quiet for a second！」
She stepped forward aggressively, glaring at Arakawa.

name: Ririmu
message: 「I was thinking this during the match, too—what's your deal？ Swinging a stick around just to kill time while wearing that flashy outfit！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I'm betting my life on Jindou, and this outfit is part of my world view！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Heh... if that's the case, then yours is a pretty cheap life.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hah！？ I don't know what kind of painful experiences you've been through, Senpai！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But my life isn't so carefree that you can just dismiss it as cheap！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「...Then tell me, have you ever had an iron rod that was stuck in a bonfire pressed against you？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Ever spent the night in the middle of a winter rain wearing nothing but a T-shirt？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Ever been stabbed by your own father with a kitchen knife without a Barrier Jacket on, and come that close to dying?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I-I haven't... ever experienced anything like that...」

name: Sonomi
message: 「That little stunt you pulled at the end? Compared to what I've been through, it was nothing.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「But you were pissing your pants over that little bit, weren't you？ That’s what it really comes down to.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「The pain and problems of you rich kids are superficial at best. As far as I'm concerned, they don't even count as hardship.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「There are plenty of people out there living through hellish struggles you don't even know exist...！」
Ririmu falls silent under the sheer intensity of Arakawa's presence.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Jindou is nothing more than a game for the warrior class.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「But y'know, it's also a game that can be used to crush those very people from the warrior class who take it so seriously.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「You get that, Tobe Ririmu?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「I do Jindou for the sole purpose of knocking down flighty little princesses like you who don't know the first thing about the real world.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hmph, serves you right.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「What is that... is that what I lost to...！？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Yeah, that's it. Feel the sting of it, princess.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「You lost to a shitty, poor nobody who uses a lame nagamaki and can't even afford to dress herself properly.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Guh... ughhh...」
Ririmu gnashes her teeth.

name: Sonomi
message: 「That last move of yours—you couldn't even control your own power. What was that？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「I don't know how you even managed to show up for a match in that state. You haven't trained enough, you idiot！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Worst of all, you were screaming your head off at a phantom you created yourself.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Don't go getting spooked by your own damn tricks！ Don't you have any shame as a swordsman?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hic... b-but I... I tried my best...！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「You ran out of breath halfway through, and that's your 'best'？ That's exactly why you're just a pampered rich girl！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「If you really wanted to win, you should've been running five hours a day！ That’s what it means to actually try！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Everything you do is half-assed！ That's why you're always coddling yourself！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Gh... u, uuu... uuuuuuu...！！」
Finally, Ririmu burst into tears.

name: Sonomi
message: 「You don't put in any real effort, but you still bark like a loser. That's why your Jindou is nothing more than child's play.」
...I had stayed quiet because Ririmu told me to, but my patience was wearing thin.
Just as I thought that and started to speak up—

name: Asahi
message: 「...That is enough！！！」
Asahi shouted.

name: Asahi
message: 「I've been listening to you in silence, but you keep saying whatever you please. Without even knowing the first thing about Ririmu-san...！！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「No, I know plenty. We just fought, and I won. She put on a pathetic display and lost to me.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「What else do I need to know beyond that？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「In the world of competition, once you lose, anything you say is just the howling of a loser...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ririmu-san has... put in more effort than any normal person. I have been by her side watching that the whole time.」

name: Asahi
message: 「She has never once let her wealth make her arrogant, nor has she ever neglected her training.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ririmu-san does not deserve to be insulted by a despicable, pathetic person like you who turns their own circumstances into violence against others.」

name: Asahi
message: 「So, retract your statement right now...！」
With her words filled with indignation and resolve, Asahi declares.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Heh, so you're trying to pick a fight with me? Interesting...！」
She met Asahi’s gaze, glaring back with eyes full of madness.

name: Asahi
message: 「You will apologize to Ririmu-san, one way or another...！！」

name: Iori
message: 「...Asahi, let's leave it at that.」

name: Asahi
message: 「No, Iori-sensei... I cannot back down here！」
It was fortunate that neither of them had their Origami in hand, but the situation was at a breaking point.

name: Sonomi
message: 「...Tch, I can't even get into a proper fight with a teacher hanging around.」
Perhaps feeling her momentum fade, Arakawa-san turned on her heel.

name: Asahi
message: 「Wait! Are you trying to run away!!」

name: Sonomi
message: 「...Demanding I retract my words or bow my head—how annoying. If you're a fencer, there's a more straightforward way to handle this, right?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「If it burns you up so much, try beating me. If you do that, I'll be forced to bow my head whether I like it or not.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Fine. I’ll be the one to avenge you, Ririmu.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hah, what spirit. Then you’d better make sure you survive until you face me.」
Saying that much, Arakawa finally left.

name: Ririmu
message: 「……sniff, ugh……」
Beaten to the punch by Asahi, I found myself with no role to play. I reached out, thinking to at least comfort Ririmu.

name: Ririmu
message: 「……what do you think you’re doing.」
Startled, I pulled my hand back.

name: Asahi
message: 「Ririmu...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「What do you think you’re doing, Asahi！」
Ririmu looked up, her face burning with anger.

name: Ririmu
message: 「My match is my own, and my loss is my own, too!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「It has nothing to do with you, Asahi！」

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu, that’s……」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Stay out of this, Teach！」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, right……」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I…… I couldn’t say a single thing back to her. It was so, so frustrating……！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But, that frustration is mine！ Don’t go taking it for yourself, Asahi！」

name: Asahi
message: 「……I’m sorry.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ugh, jeez, I wanted to win too！ I wanted to go to the main tournament too！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「If you just swoop in and steal the spotlight like that, then I’m just a joke, aren’t I！！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「‘Avenge me,’ my foot！ Don’t act so cool！ I never asked you to do that for me！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I hate this! You’re an idiot, Asahi, waaaaaaah!!!」
Crying, Ririmu ran off.
Neither Asahi nor I went after her. Because even if we did, we had no words to offer her.

name: Asahi
message: 「I wonder… did I hurt Ririmu’s feelings……」

name: Iori
message: 「It’ll be okay, Asahi.」
Ririmu must know that Asahi didn't speak up to Arakawa with any malicious intent.
But that is exactly why it hurts.
There are times when a person just can't honestly accept the kindness directed toward them.

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu will surely bounce back. So until then, it's best we leave her be.」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Understood.」

name: Asahi
message: 「However, whether Ririmu-san wants it or not, I will not budge on this.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I will make sure Arakawa Sonomi bows her head to her.」
Asahi's eyes, filled with hidden resolve, looked as though they wouldn't change no matter what words were spoken to her.

name: Iori
message: 「...You're right. Let's do our best.」
With that encouragement, I gave Asahi's shoulder a gentle pat.
